objective: Reduce BUKLOD sponsored video late autoplay, unnecessary repeated sponsored-media downloads, and delayed Wall next-video visibility while preserving full-quality original images/video and scoped advertisement delivery.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source 9f412afd71b74e41995a3a1a63e05e72f78b6e39 is repository source, not live-runtime attestation. Parent staging DEV integration head 6b0f7e3167867bb746e34da4637430f131b588bb, PR #790 is draft and unmerged. Supabase 2026-11-14 recent 60-minute logs show 53 CDN requests totaling ~2.18 GB for one 50.9 MB paid-ad video and ~2.93 GB total Storage response bytes; cannot treat this as precise monthly billed cached egress. Actual installed staging/prod OTA not verified.
chosenApproach: Activate one sponsored player when at most 0.6 viewport from screen, buffer in advance using the existing original URL, use expo-video native disk caching with bounded forward buffer and retain view-matched pause. Use layout-frame check plus 120ms viewport sampling and change Wall video-only FlatList visibility delay to zero without loosening AdMob impressions.
selectionRationale: Current sponsored polling waits 350ms then up to 900ms and lazily no native cache; nearby player prewarm and cache remove both delays and re-downloads without downscaling or offscreen playback. Already deployed Wall and Marites caching/preload mechanisms remain unchanged.
alternativeApproaches: Only reduce poll from 900ms (rejected; video may still cold-buffer without prewarm or caching)
Always mount and autoplay every sponsor (rejected; bandwidth and Android decoder overload)
Transcode to low-resolution proxy (rejected; user explicitly protects original image/video sharpness)
preserveBehaviors: Approved paid unexpired geo-matched sponsor selection, rotation, impression/click accounting, and campaign dates remain unchanged.
No app runtime, native dependency, Supabase, AdMob, RLS, media URL, contentFit, image sizing or compression changes.
Other audio owners, PTT, on-blur/app-background pause, weak-network fallback and offscreen player disposal remain.
Wall single visible clip and bounded next-video preloading; Marites existing native disk caching unchanged.
No production, web, native APK or OTA publish; staging branch source must pass RC checks before promotion.
acceptanceChecks: When a paid sponsored clip approaches the screen, its native player prepares at most 0.6 screen ahead; starts on exposure without artificial 350-900ms wait.
When scrolled far away, sponsored video is unmounted and stopped; revisiting uses same native cache and full-quality file.
Wall video visibility triggers on first 25% exposure with no artificial dwell; AdMob uses original 60%/400ms.
Background, tab blur, audio focus and campaign expiry stop or remove playback appropriately.
Focused new behavioral/contract tests and existing media/nav regression tests pass; TypeScript and Android compile gate required before staging RC.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Targeted sponsored and Wall video playback timing/storage source improvement with no native ABI changes.
preservedBehaviors: Existing navigation, media resolution, audio and app background life cycle remain unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Improve paid sponsorship playback readiness while keeping campaign eligibility, impression counting and billing unchanged.
preservedBehaviors: Existing paid ad approval/payment/geo/expiry gates, AdMob and accounting events remain unchanged.
